name: Blacksmith Forge
defaultDescriptions: A wave of intense heat and the rhythmic clanging of heavy steel on iron fills the Blacksmith Forge.
Sparks shower from the central hearth as glowing ingots are hammered into shape. Armor stands display reinforced chainmail, iron plate, and polished edge weapons.

3,4: You stand near the wide open doorway of the smithy, cooling breeze cutting through the forge heat.
A stone quench trough sits near the threshold beside stacks of seasoned firewood and charcoal.
3,2: You stand before the massive anvil where Blacksmith Donald wields a massive forging hammer with effortless orcish power.
Donald inspects a freshly tempered blade, sparks bouncing off his thick leather apron.

armor_displays: Heavy timber mannequins suited with riveted chain vests, studded armguards, and reinforced greaves.
blazing_forge: A massive brick furnace fed by bellow-pumped air, radiating white-hot coals capable of melting iron and forging alloys.
heavy_anvil: A massive block of hardened steel anchored in an ancient stump, bearing decades of hammer marks.

triggers.label: Speak with Blacksmith Donald
triggers.tooltip: Browse martial armaments, repair gear, or inquire about metalwork.
triggers.description: Blacksmith Donald sets his heavy hammer down on the anvil and crosses his massive arms with a deep, rumbling grunt of greeting.
